workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: OpenAI 429 `credit_balance_exhausted` is classified as rate_limit_error, so ordered credentials keep retrying an unfunded key
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(models): classify exhausted credit balances as quota errors. Target files: openviking/models/model_error.py, tests/unit/test_model_retry.py, tests/unit/test_retry_vlm.py. Classify the structured `credit_balance_exhausted` provider code as `QUOTA_EXHAUSTED`, like `insufficient_quota`. A 429 carrying this code currently consumes RetryVLM's retry budget on an unfunded credential before trying the next credential. It should make one attempt and immediately use the existing quota failover path. (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7308)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: 书签目标写在 /A /GoTo 动作中的 PDF 全部无法解析，章节结构丢失
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(pdf): 解析写在 /A /GoTo 动作中的书签目标. Target files: openviking/parse/parsers/pdf.py, tests/parse/test_pdf_bookmark_extraction.py. 本地导入 PDF 时，书签会用来生成章节。之前解析器只读取书签的 `/Dest`；若同一目标写在 `/A << /S /GoTo /D [...] >>`，正文仍能提取，但该书签无法定位页码，因此不能生成对应章节。 (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7077)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Markdown directory link rewriting changes literal links in code examples
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(parse): preserve relative link examples in Markdown code. Target files: openviking/parse/parsers/markdown.py, tests/parse/test_markdown_link_rewrite.py. . Directory ingestion rewrites relative Markdown links to account for the document’s new location. The same pass also rewrites link syntax shown as literal text in fenced code blocks and inline code spans. (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7220)
